newsitem.title: USA: Belgium debt should move into Euros early - Maystadt.
newsitem.headline: Belgium debt should move into Euros early - Maystadt.

text.p: Belgian Finance Minister Philippe Maystadt said on Tuesday he believed Belgium should convert its stock of debt into euros as soon as possible after the launch of the single European currency.
But in an interview with Reuters he said he could not say how quickly this would be, and said Belgium would have to look into the technical and legal issues involved.

EU leaders agreed in Madrid last December that countries should issue all new debt in euros after the start of European monetary union in 1999 but left it to individual member states to decide when to convert their stock of debt, provided this was done before 2002, when notes and coins go into circulation.
"We should convert our public debt into euros as soon as possible," Maystadt said.

France has already said it will convert its stock of debt as soon as possible after Janaury 1, 1999, while Bundesbank Chief Economist Otmar Issing said on Monday that Germany should make every effort to convert the bulk of its outstanding debt that year.
